objective: SYNTHETIC B/C points generated from the profile's prediction at an ILLUSTRATIVE truth point

observable.process: secondary-to-primary ratio B/C from spallation of C and O on interstellar hydrogen

phase_space.definition: local interstellar ratio at the Galactic mid-plane (z = 0), before solar modulation

observable.frame: Galactic rest frame (interstellar gas at rest)

normalization.convention: ratio of two fluxes at the same E/n; the normalization cancels

conventions.unit_system: CGS for transport (cm, s, g; D in cm^2/s, n_H in cm^-3, grammage in g/cm^2); lengths L and h given in kpc (1 pc = 648000/pi au); kinetic energy per nucleon in GeV/n; rigidity in GV; cross sections in mb (1 mb = 1e-27 cm^2) [crsr:C05]
conventions.energy_variable: kinetic energy per nucleon E/n in GeV/n, conserved in fragmentation (straight-ahead); the ratio compares fluxes at the same E/n
conventions.frame: Galactic rest frame (interstellar gas at rest); observer at the disc mid-plane z = 0
conventions.mass_approximation: nucleus mass = A x atomic mass unit (0.93149410242 GeV; binding energy neglected), so all species share beta at fixed E/n; rigidity R = (A/|Z|) p_per_nucleon via core/kinematics/relativistic.py; target hydrogen mass m_H = proton mass 1.67262192369e-24 g (electron and binding neglected) [crsr:C05]
conventions.crsr:observable: B/C = N_B / N_C, interstellar fluxes of an effective single boron species (A = 11, Z = 5) and carbon (A = 12, Z = 6) at the same E/n, at z = 0, before solar modulation
conventions.crsr:cross_sections: input sets under models/ (xs-*.json): effective cumulative production sigma(j -> B) and inelastic sigma_i on hydrogen, energy independent; the shipped sets are ILLUSTRATIVE placeholders; a choice between sets is a model-alternative uncertainty object
conventions.crsr:bin_average: a binned value is the ratio averaged uniformly in ln(E/n) over the bin (Gauss-Legendre, 8 nodes), not the ratio of bin-averaged fluxes
conventions.crsr:transport_model: diffusion-1d: thin disc of half-thickness h and density n_H in a halo |z| < L with N(+-L) = 0, D(R) = D0 beta (R/R0)^delta, no convection, reacceleration, losses or decay; weighted-slab: exponential path-length distribution with mean lambda_esc

uncertainties.name: total (3% statistical uncorrelated + 2% systematic, correlation length 1.5 in ln E)
